highest_priority.title: Define the domain adapter SDK and conformance test harness
highest_priority.reason: The adapter foundation exists, but future domains need a documented SDK and conformance tests before new adapters are added.

highest_priority.title: Add generic domain selector and adapter-aware input UX
highest_priority.reason: The UI must expose domains and adapter examples instead of behaving like a watch-only shell.

highest_priority.title: Create a universal evidence and confidence model
highest_priority.reason: Trust across arbitrary products, services, and domains depends on visible provenance, data quality, and uncertainty.

highest_priority.title: Build the first non-watch services comparison adapter
highest_priority.reason: A services adapter proves the platform can compare non-product domains without hard-coded watch assumptions.

highest_priority.title: Define domain data source governance
highest_priority.reason: Each adapter needs clear source, freshness, and missing-data rules before the platform broadens.

selection_policy: Use GitHub Project 16 as the SSOT. Prefer one issue-scoped task per implementer heartbeat, starting with core platform/domain-adapter initiative work before watch-adapter depth or monetization.
